name: Anatomically Constrained Tractography using precomputed 5tt & CSD
summary: Runs MRtrix3 anatomically constrained tractography (ACT) from precomputed CSD fibre orientation distributions, a T1-weighted image and DWI, producing a whole-brain .tck tractogram and a DTI tensor fit.
description: A copy of the RACE-Track ensemble tractography App (brainlife.app.101) modified to take precomputed CSD and optional 5-tissue-type and DWI brain masks as inputs. It fits a tensor model (optionally on a single requested shell), builds a 5TT mask with 5ttgen fsl if none is provided, and generates streamlines with tckgen across the requested lmax values, curvature angles and tracking algorithms (deterministic, probabilistic, tensor-based, FACT), concatenating them into one tractogram. Use it when CSD has already been computed by another App; walltime grows with the number of streamlines.
